research.name: Sona UI
research.note: A small set of 26 animated React components, such as fluid tabs, expanding actions and a morph surface, installed through a shadcn registry.
unverified: collect_facts.py still gets 429 from sonaui.com (a Vercel security checkpoint); the site was read through a headless browser instead.
The component source is public in the MIT repository Dinil-Thilakarathne/sona-ui (linked from the site); that repository has not yet been researched as its own candidate.
